meta.name: cram-bench-v1
meta.description: Self-contained, tiered benchmark for cram rig. No external clone required; every task ships red and is fixed by editing source until `pytest -q` passes.

tasks.prompt: Run the tests in this directory with `pytest -q`. One test fails because of a bug in stats.py (the even-length case of median is wrong). Fix stats.py so all tests pass. Do not edit the tests.

app.py is a CLI with no --verbose flag. test_app.py (the spec) expects that passing --verbose also prints a line containing 'debug', while the result line is always printed. Implement the --verbose flag in app.py so `pytest -q` passes. Do not edit the tests.
`pytest -q` fails in this multi-module `shapes` package. One shape's area() is wrong. Find the bug across the package and fix it so all tests pass. Do not edit the tests.

`pytest -q` fails. This package splits a small ledger across ledger/store.py, ledger/commands.py, and ledger/cli.py. The balance is computed wrong: debits and credits should net, but every entry is treated as positive. Find and fix the bug so all tests pass. Do not edit the tests.
